# Green Wolf Maintenance and Landscaping Inc.

> Owner-operated snow removal, lawn care and landscaping company in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan, Canada. Serves Saskatoon only, for homes and businesses.

Also known as: Green Wolf; Green Wolf Maintenance & Landscaping Inc.

## Snow removal (November 1 to March 31)

- Unlimited clearing visits on every plan.
- Crews come out once 2 cm of snow has fallen and clear the property within 24 hours of the snow stopping. During multi-day snowfall, properties are cleared at least every 48 hours.
- Townhouse or small home with no driveway: $159 per month (CAD).
- Single-car driveway: from $219 per month.
- Double-car driveway: from $249 per month.
- Full season (November 1 to March 31) costs 10% less than paying monthly: from $715, $985 and $1,120.
- Every plan includes the city sidewalk, front walk and front steps. Driveway plans include the driveway and approach.
- Quoted separately: ice melt, back or side entrances, corner lots with extra city sidewalk, extended driveways and rear parking pads.
- Priority routes in Hampton Village, Rosewood and Brighton. All Saskatoon neighbourhoods are served.
- Contract customers are cleared first. One-time visits depend on capacity.

## Lawn care (spring to fall)

- Weekly mowing and trimming from $99 per month.
- Weed control, fertilization and specialty lawn treatments, quoted separately.
- Commercial lawn care for businesses and property managers.

## Landscaping and seasonal cleanup

- Landscaping: sod, pavers, decorative rock, edging and grading. Fully booked for 2026; now booking 2027 projects.
- Spring and fall cleanup: fully booked for 2026; the 2027 booking list is open.
